# Disposable Lark feature canary evidence

Status: not run; separate live authorization was not provided.

This directory must contain only sanitized opaque IDs, SHA-256 digests, status
summaries and the procedure below. Never add credentials, private identities,
chat/document bodies, source code, prompts, model input/output or trace payloads.

Before a canary, record an approved manifest digest and verify an isolated test
tenant, a disposable chat and document parent, consenting test open IDs, a
temporary SDK repository/worktree, a Fornax test workspace/target, retention
and cleanup ownership. Verify exact CLI/bridge/SDK versions and the reviewed
Lark single-writer revision-aware document capability. Stop if any value is
missing or ambiguous, or if any user/application could write the owned canary
documents concurrently.

Run exactly one workflow requirement after explicit mutation authorization.
Capture sanitized workflow run, four node/thread, group, two document/revision,
three approval, goal, root trace and local/remote delivery correlations. Review
the complete gate history, goal evidence, six-type trace tree and secret-canary
scan. Do not infer remote delivery from a local bridge acknowledgement.

On any failure, disable new runs and preserve all journals and correlations.
Do not automatically retry an ambiguous mutation or delete a group, document,
goal, thread, trace or worktree. Cleanup is a separately authorized owner action.
